MUTATIONS: the job runs an owner cycle only for the stored request; a mutant that reads pending without it starts one for any ring, so a planted file's payload would change what runs (SPEC-059 R2)
a request for the job is made only after the owner gate admits the update; a gate that admits anyone lets a stranger ring the doorbell (SPEC-026 R4; SPEC-059 A6)
SCRIPT_MUTATIONS: a directory other users can enter lets another process ring the doorbell; only the bot unit's ReadWritePaths= may write it (SPEC-059 R3)
PathExists= is level triggered and, with a job that never consumes the file, starts the sync again and again; PathChanged= starts it once per change (SPEC-059 R4)
the bot's sandbox is read-only outside its paths, so without the directory it cannot ring the doorbell and the owner is never served (SPEC-059 R3)
